pr_title: ES|QL: Disable optimizations that rely on Expression.nullable()
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/104995

This PR disables all the planning optimizations that rely on `Expression.nullable()`. 
The semantics of this QL API have changed significantly in ESQL, so for now we'll just remove all the code that uses it. See also comments [here](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/105023#issuecomment-1955640677)
pr_comments: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Thanks @astefan, makes sense.
I added unit tests for all the rules I changed, and I realized that I could simplify some overrides.

> The original method returns null IF the expression is nullable which is true for functions only if at least one child is null. However it is also true for attributes / FieldAttributes leading to its replacement with null.

@costin the problem is that we cannot rely on nullability logic. In ESQL an expression can be null also in other situations, eg. mv or number overflows.

> In might be that in the SQL planner this didn't get a chance kick in because of the other rules - one fix would be to change the nullify method.

The problem doesn't kick in in SQL for two reasons:
- in ESQL we have `PropagateEvalFoldables` that injects constants where SQL had attributes
- SQL can rely on nullability logic, ESQL cannot

I tried to change `nullify()`, but it didn't work: at that stage it's too late, I tried to summarize it in the [comments above](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/105691#discussion_r1515823851)
`elasticsearch-ci/rest-compatibility` finished and was green, but for some reason  GitHub after a few hours still didn't see it...

issue_context.title: ES|QL: Bug in filtering of null values on multivalued
issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.12.0

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

Elastic Cloud

### Problem Description

Adding a singlevalue and a multivalue field returns null — this is expected. When wanting to exclude the row from the final result set, I tried to do this with `WHERE sum IS NOT NULL`. This does not exclude the row from the result.

Surprisingly, the opposite condition excludes it (`WHERE sum IS NULL`). It feels like this is the wrong way around?

### Steps to Reproduce

Query:

```
POST _query?format=txt
{
  "query": """
    ROW a = 5, b = [ 1, 2 ]
    | EVAL a - 3, b + 2, sum = a + b
    | LIMIT 1
    | WHERE sum IS NOT NULL
  """
}
```

### Logs (if relevant)

_No response_
comments:
Most likely the problem is in [OptimizerRules$FoldNull](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ql/optimizer/OptimizerRules.java#L1673) and in [Expressions.nullable()](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ql/expression/Expressions.java#L83).
These are QL components, and since SQL/EQL have a slightly different behavior regarding multi-values, they could not fit ESQL needs completely.

We can adopt a precautionary approach and disable that rule completely, or we could override `nullable()` method for all the ESQL operators. For sure we'll have to do it for arithmetic operators and for binary comparisons (the same bug happens if we replace `a + b` with `a == b`)

The problem seems to be more extended: `nullable()` is used by other rules and components like `BinaryComparisonSimplification`, `InferIsNotNull`, `PropagateNullable`

And it's not limited to binary operators, but it also extends to functions, eg. the following has the same problem:

```
ROW a = "foo", b = [ "bar", "baz" ]| EVAL c = concat(a, b)| LIMIT 1 |  WHERE c IS NOT NULL
```

review_comments: Move here under this "Null folding" section also `testBasicNullFolding` method.
I don't think this class is needed anymore.
We still need it unfortunately, It's there because FoldNull.rule() is protected, and it's used also by `AbstractFuncitonTestCase`
Unless we want to make it public in ESQL
